about_the_game:
Build sprawling cities for your hero to search and survive in with the Doomsday Tiles Urban pack! PVGames continues their Doomsday series with a huge set of 3D-modeled tiles perfect for building concrete and steel city parallax maps. This pack includes more than 7,500 images to help your maps match your vision, with towering buildings, shattered asphalt, piles of rubble, and crates and barrels ready to create busy streets and quiet alleys to explore. Each tile comes in multiple angles so you could even fill a whole room with boxes and have it not look repetitive!

Lead your players’ eyes to specific streets by placing destroyed cars and concrete barricades along the path, and make sure that it’s clear which roads aren’t walkable with massive craters in the ground and piles of bricks and trash from nearby buildings that have partially collapsed. Build custom houses with a variety of flooring and wall options, and add some helpful supplies to the ruined rooms by placing bottles of water and fuel cans on scorched tables and tucked behind broken bookshelves. Need a few more buildings to fill out a city block, but don’t have any specific designs in mind for them? Then grab one of this pack’s 100+ building exteriors to add those necessary buildings to the background. 30+ building and room interiors also make it easy to create little areas to reward your players who check every alley and unlock every door they come across. If you’ve been dreaming of making a post-apocalyptic game or want to make a city that was abandoned after the Zombie Wars, pick up the Doomsday Tiles Urban pack!


Contents:

* Large ruined buildings, interiors and exteriors.
* Destroyed and ruined vehicles.
* All sorts of barrels, trash cans, dumpsters, and more.
* Numerous urban doodads such as air conditioners, air ducts, and more.
* Barriers and barricades, including chain-link, concrete, and makeshift.
* Everything needed to create interior environments, from beds, shelves, bottles, and tables to chairs, rugs, and so much more.
* Debris, clutter, and detritus to scuzzy up your urban wasteland.
* A variety of roads and other types of grounds that can be mixed and matched.
* Numerous street lights, street signs, power poles, and other urban décor.
* Vending machines, railway cars, televisions, shopping carts, shipping containers, racks of goods, and tons more to create a large variety of stores, apartments, and other locations.
* Makeshift shelters.
* Ruins, broken equipment, destroyed walls, crumbled concrete and asphalt.

And much more!

These tiles are fully compatible with all other PVGames tiles from the RPGTools line of assets. They go together especially well with the Cyber City assets.

*Please note that the tiles in this pack are not formatted as tilesheets. They are all individual PNG graphics.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
